description: Gate 3 (PROJECT_PLAN.md §9, decisions 9-10; job J8; D31): the design chosen by gate2a-fix (Gate 2b not rerun: plan defaults), one seed, with 4 inner fits per outer fold (each holds out 2 of the 8 training tools and trains for the outer fit's kept step) giving the out-of-fold predictions that calibrate the 90 % intervals. Outer fits are copied from gate2a-fix (B1). Method b (out-of-fold Student-t scale) and c (cross-conformal) compete by validation Winkler score under coverage in [0.85, 0.95]; method a is fitted on the validation tool and only reported. The causal filter is tested by Rule A. Nothing trained changes (D15).
